description: A Python script for generating a product bundle balance report in an ERP system, involving data retrieval, processing, and report generation functions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate columns and data for the product bundle balance report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines and returns the report columns.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves item details, product bundle details, parent items, and child items based on filters.

methods.name: get_stock_balance
methods.description: Calculates stock balance for items based on stock ledger entries.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entries filtered by item codes and other conditions.

methods.name: get_parent_item_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for parent item selection based on filters.

methods.name: get_sle_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for stock ledger entries based on filters, including date and warehouse.
